name: AudioClips
description: Tap-to-play audio clips in the packaged EPUB: a reading-system script and styles for the span.clip markup that the Djot and MarkdownIt transforms produce from the :clip directive, plus two independent per-clip options: the play affordance (a text glyph by default, or a circled play/stop icon with data-affordance=icon, or none) and an animated progress indicator (ring, bar, or waveform with data-progress, or none). Both take the surrounding text colour. Chapters with clips get one static audio element (required by iOS Books); inline your own <audio controls> to make the player visible.
